title: Synthesis and structures of cobalt-expanded zirconium- and cerium-oxo clusters as precursors for mixed-metal oxide thin films

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, (NH4)2[Ce(NO3)6] (1.10 g, 2.0 mmol, 1.0 eq.) was dissolved in ethanol (10 mL) with stirring at ambient temperature. Pivalic acid (0.816 g, 8.0 mmol, 4.0 eq.) was added to the orange solution, causing a color change to yellow. Triethylamine (1.38 mL, 10.0 mmol, 5.0 eq.) was then added, immediately forming a pale-yellow powder. The powder was collected by filtration and washed with a small amount of water and ice-cold EtOH. Pale-yellow single crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction were obtained by recrystallization of the powder from MeOH:DMF (5:2 v/v).
synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirred solution under aerobic conditions; filtration; recrystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Pale-yellow powder collected by filtration, washed with water and ice-cold EtOH, air-dried. Recrystallized from MeOH:DMF (5:2 v/v) to give pale-yellow single crystals.

source_locations.location: Introduction and ESI Table S2 / Figure S10

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, freshly prepared [Ce6O4(OH)4(piv)12] (0.195 g, 0.09 mmol, 1.0 eq.), Co(piv)2 (0.200 g, 0.8 mmol, 8.9 eq.), and N-butyldiethanolamine (0.17 mL, 1.0 mmol, 11 eq.) were dissolved in MeCN (10 mL). Triethylamine (0.05 mL, 0.36 mmol, 4.0 eq.) was added and the mixture was stirred under reflux for 2 h. The resulting dark-green solution was filtered and the filtrate stored in a sealed vial at ambient conditions. Dark-red single crystals of 1 suitable for X-ray diffraction formed after one day. The product was collected by filtration, washed with ice-cold MeCN and a small amount of n-pentane, and dried in air.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: one-pot reflux in MeCN under aerobic conditions; filtration; sealed-vial crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Dark-green filtrate stored in a sealed vial at ambient conditions; dark-red single crystals after one day; collected by filtration, washed with ice-cold MeCN and n-pentane, air-dried.
